sender.sr: „Smeštaj” ili „Booking” u poruci, sa vašim pravim podacima o rezervaciji
sender.en: “The property” or “Booking” in a message, with your real booking details

name.sr: Lažna poruka o rezervaciji smeštaja: verifikujte karticu ili hitno platite
name.en: Fake accommodation booking message: verify your card or pay urgently

how.sr: Posle krađe podataka sa platforme Booking, prevaranti pišu u ime smeštaja ili platforme i znaju vaše ime i datume. Javljaju problem sa plaćanjem i traže „verifikaciju” kartice preko linka ili hitnu uplatu, inače će rezervacija biti otkazana.
how.en: After data was stolen from the Booking platform, scammers write in the name of the property or the platform and know your name and dates. They report a payment problem and ask you to “verify” your card through a link or pay urgently, or the booking will be cancelled.

text.sr: Poruka smeštaja ili platforme sa vašim podacima.
text.en: A message from the property or platform with your details.
A link outside the official app.
Card verification or a direct payment.

text.sr: Poštovani, u vezi sa vašim boravkom od 12. do 19. jula: banka nije odobrila autorizaciju kartice. Molimo potvrdite podatke u narednih 12 sati, u suprotnom sistem automatski otkazuje rezervaciju. [link]
text.en: Dear guest, regarding your stay from 12 to 19 July: the bank did not approve the card authorisation. Please confirm your details within the next 12 hours, otherwise the system cancels the booking automatically. [link]

sr: booking poruka problem sa plaćanjem kartica
rezervacija smeštaja biće otkazana potvrdite karticu
hotel piše na whatsapp hitna uplata rezervacija
znaju datume rezervacije traže podatke kartice
en: accommodation booking will be cancelled confirm card
property asks for card verification link
hotel writes on whatsapp urgent payment booking
they know my booking dates and want card details

sr: Podatke kartice unosite samo u zvaničnoj aplikaciji ili na sajtu platforme.
Tačni podaci o rezervaciji ne dokazuju da je poruka prava: podaci su procureli.
en: Only enter card details in the platform’s official app or website.
Correct booking details don’t prove a message is real: the data leaked.
A request to pay outside the platform.

sr: Ne otvarajte link. Rezervaciju proverite sami u aplikaciji.
Ne šaljite podatke kartice porukom. Razmislite o nižem dnevnom limitu za plaćanje na internetu.
Ako ste upisali karticu, odmah je blokirajte i prijavite slučaj.
en: Don’t open the link. Check the booking yourself in the app.
Don’t send card details by message. Consider a lower daily limit for online payments.
If you entered your card, block it at once and report it.

sources.title: MUP povodom krađe podataka korisnika sajta Booking: Obratite pažnju na sve transakcije
